The '''1984 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 40th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The season began on 29 April 1984 and ended 14 October 1984, not including play-off matches.<ref>{{cite web|title=1. divisjon 1984 (Norge)|url=https://www.nifs.no/kamper.php?land=1&t=5&u=26
|website=nifs.no|publisher=NTB|access-date=7 June 2019|language=no}}</ref>

==Overview==
22 games were played with 2 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve were relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]] were promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between number ten in the 1. divisjon and the two second-placed teams in the two groups of the 2. divisjon. 

[[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerengen]] won the championship, their fourth title.
